name: Cloud Destination Accounts - Authorized [ends with]
description: Intent: Authorized cloud destination accounts — populate with tenant-suffix patterns identifying sanctioned cloud-storage accounts (e.g., @acme.com.box.com, @acme.onedrive.com, acme.sharepoint.com, acme-okta). Drives the Authorized split on D2000 / M2000 (Internal cloud storage activity, low-noise visibility) and is negated to partition the Unauthorized cloud surface on D2010 / M2010 / W2010 / B2000. Top priority to populate — this is the primary discriminator between sanctioned and shadow cloud tenants. Exclusions: do not add free/personal cloud accounts (gmail.com, personal OneDrive) unless your org licenses them as corporate identities; do not add competing cloud vendors that aren't actually sanctioned.
